sources.entry: SPIP - Publication system for the Internet aimed at collaborative work, multilingual environments, and simplicity of use for web authors. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.name: SPIP
summary.one_liner: SPIP is a free, GPL-licensed publication system for the Internet, built for collaborative work, multilingual sites and ease of use, with this site serving as its official French documentation.
use_cases: run an association or institutional website
publish a personal or commercial website
summary.what_it_does: ["SPIP is a publication system for the Internet that emphasises collective workflows, multilingual content and ease of use for web authors.", "It is free software distributed under the GNU General Public License.", "It can be used for any kind of website, including associative, institutional, personal or commercial sites.", "The software is developed, documented and translated by a community that invites people to join through websites, mailing lists and meetups.", "The page states it was started in 2001 by the minirézo collective and is now used on tens of thousands of varied sites."]
notable: Designed for collaborative work by multiple authors
Licensed under GPL-3.0 and written in PHP
Started in 2001 by the minirézo collective
caveats: The page text is in French and gives few technical details on installation or requirements beyond the listing's PHP mention.
